purpose: Teach: 洗浄/貸付/清算/通商/投機/知名度/推計/税込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場の洗浄設備を更新しろ
lines.en: I want the factory cleaning equipment updated.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Brief pause after the opening. Direct eye contact. No room for discussion — this is directive, not collaborative. Slight forward lean.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員への貸付制度を整えました
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged a staff loan program.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Measured pace. Respectful but not deferential. Delivers the action taken with quiet competence, no embellishment. Eyes steady on the boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、月末の清算を早めろ
lines.style: Hard stops on each phrase. Quiet authority without volume. Hands still. The tone of someone who's thought this through and expects execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。通商交渉が進展しております
lines.en: Yes. Trade negotiations are moving forward.
lines.style: Level, informative tone. No inflection of pride or worry — just facts. Brief natural pause after 'Yes.' Professional and calm, like he's already thought three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員に投機的な判断はさせるな
lines.en: Don't let the staff make speculative decisions.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Weight on the word 'don't' — not angry, but unmistakable. Slower pace than the others. A warning that sounds like care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告で知名度を上げる計画です
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to raise brand awareness through advertising.
lines.style: Direct response. Steady pacing. Acknowledges the directive while showing he's already working on the solution. Confident but not presumptuous — he's aligning his work with the boss's thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、来月の売上を推計しろ
lines.en: Get me a sales estimate for next month.
lines.style: Efficient and final. Short phrases, slight space between them. The closing question of a meeting. Matter-of-fact tone — this is standard business, not urgent or relaxed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品は税込みで価格表示いたします
lines.en: Yes. The new product pricing will display with tax included.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly slower and more deliberate than the mid-line responses. Signals closure — the action is clear and complete. Respectful bow in the voice without obsequiousness.
